p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start-up of a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the updated official sources so you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, customs, duties, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Card (MAC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations that this country imposes on products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check that a platform has not been flagged by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: Use your browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document.When making an important decision, ask a professional in the country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: an authorized customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Cards (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: Taric: customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.cu_t4: French customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: Seller hands over the export-cleared goods to buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on board the ship; then the risk and cost are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), certain drugs.Such lists are rejected and can be reported (a).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything on these links: You compare here, then you send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash pick-up in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash pick-up
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash pick-up
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount: fees + exchange rate. A rate that is worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to “unlock” a prize, package, loan or visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the right price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means that you sell a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer – easy to start with, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no regulated product without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / Supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumers’ rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the EU, a parcel from a non-EU country pays VAT from the first euro.
